messages:
alex: Starting the SDK publish window for py/ts now — canary to npm/pypi. tagging v2.4.0-canary and publishing from ci. will post status here.

deploy-bot: [publish/py] build started (job 8412)

maria: copied the changelog into the release notes draft, adding the deprecation blurb for legacy sync client.

deploy-bot: [publish/ts] npm publish triggered (job 9921) -> registry 200 OK

kevin: seeing a 400 from pypi upload in CI logs: "HTTPError: 400 Bad Request - File has incorrect hash". attaching logs...

alex: ack. that's the wheel checksum failure we fixed last week in the packaging script? did the build use the updated wheel builder image?

liz: CI shows image tag sdk-builder:2024-11-08 but we merged the fix to use sdk-builder:2024-11-10. looks like the runner didn't pick the latest image.

maria: can we re-run the py job with the updated image quickly? if not we should hold the canary publish to avoid partial rollout.

kevin: re-run queued, but job fails again with same checksum. runner caches still pointing to older docker layers.

alex: HOLD the TS publish from npm — revert the dist-tag if already added, and stop promoting canary to `latest`. we don't want mixed client versions across languages.

kevin: ran: `npm dist-tag ls @redwood/sdk` shows `canary: 2.4.0-canary`. Running: `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk canary` now. response: ok.

deploy-bot: [action] npm dist-tag removal completed by kevin at 1745550195

liz: for python, I'm going to yank the pypi release candidate (if any) and add a manual hold in the release tracker.

maria: I'll update the release notes header with a short note: "Publish held due to packaging checksum errors; investigating. No user-facing changes released." Also flag the deprecation blurb as not-yet-published.

alex: decision: hold the entire publish window until packaging fix confirmed on CI. Plan B: if we can't unblock in 2 hours, we'll roll the TS canary back (we already removed the canary tag) and schedule a new publish window tomorrow morning with a stricter pre-publish checklist.

kevin: checklist item to add: force docker pull of sdk-builder image and clear layer cache in runner before build. I'll add a short script to CI:

```
# ensure fresh build environment
docker pull registry.internal/redwood/sdk-builder:2024-11-10 || true
docker image prune -f || true
```

kevin: also adding a post-upload verification step: verify sha256 of wheel on pypi matches local digest. failing that step will abort and notify channel.

liz: tagging ops: @alex @maria @kevin. I'll mark the release tracker as HOLD and create an incident note for customer-success so they know not to expect new SDK behavior.

maria: for deprecation messaging: keep the draft internal-only until we confirm the canary is live. don't update public docs yet.

alex: thanks team. once CI green for both publish jobs, we'll re-open this thread and run a targeted smoke test matrix: install-py, install-ts, run basic chat+embed calls, verify version headers. post smoke results here before promoting to `latest` and publishing release notes publicly. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [ci] queued job re-run 8412 -> failed at 1745550302 (checksum mismatch).

kevin: putting the pipeline into debug mode and running locally to reproduce. will update in ~20m.

liz: noted. I'm keeping the release window blocked on the calendar and pinging support with "no release in this window".

alex: if we don't have a green run by 1745556000 (2 hours), we schedule the rollforward for tomorrow and cut a small postmortem on the checklist gap.

kevin: understood. moving to debug.
